category: in-memory key-value (data structures, Query Engine, JSON)
notes: Redis Open Source 8 (RediSearch/JSON/TimeSeries/probabilistic modules built in). Async primary->replica replication with diskless sync, AOF everysec on both; 3 Sentinels (quorum 2, down-after 2 s) elect a new primary; HAProxy round-robins reads over primary+replica. Documents are hashes with application-maintained index sets/zsets; FT.CREATE on products for text + vector.

strategy.tool: BGSAVE (fork, point-in-time RDB) then copy dump.rdb off the box; AOF everysec keeps the gap between snapshots small
strategy.consistency: point-in-time (fork + copy-on-write); one file per instance
strategy.restore: offline: stop, install the RDB as the multipart-AOF base file (appendonlydir/ + manifest) so an AOF-enabled server loads it, start; replicas full-resync
strategy.incremental: none — RDB is always full; BGREWRITEAOF compacts the AOF
strategy.pitr: no (AOF replays to the last fsync only)
strategy.schedule: `save <seconds> <changes>` rules or a cron job calling BGSAVE + copy (Sentinel/replica-aware)
strategy.retention: external: rotate the copied RDB files
